newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S GIANT SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S GIANT SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Michael Von Gruenigen, the winner of a men's World Cup giant slalom on Sunday:
Overall World Cup wins: 9 - Giant slalom: Veysonnaz (93), Val D'Isere (94), Tignes (95), Vail (95), Park City (95), Adelboden (96), Hinterstoder (96), Alta Badia (96), Kranjska Gora (97)
Other feats - Bronze medals in giant slalom and slalom 1996 world championships

A regular on the circuit since 1990. Von Gruenigen's goal this winter is to defend his giant slalom World Cup title and make a medal at the 1997 world championships in Sestriere, Italy. He was brought up by older sister Christine -- a former World Cup skier -- after the death of his parents when he was still a child.
